summary: Validated realtime tracking + Google Maps integration end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (nav-leg with Google Routes API, /tracking/gps + /tracking/live, breadcrumb, share-token JWT, /tracking/public/{token}, session start/current/stop, /routes/geocode cache, full E2E technician->public). Frontend: PublicTrackingPage /track/{token} renders Google Maps (window.google.maps loaded, div.gm-style mounted), polyline visible, technician marker, ETA '12 min / 3.9 km', OS info, customer name+address — exactly matching the GPS posted via backend API in the E2E test. Admin /routes page: Maps SDK loads cleanly (no InvalidKey/Billing errors, 0 page errors), route list renders. REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY fix CONFIRMED WORKING.

issues: Action icon buttons (search/edit/duplicate/delete) on each route card lack data-testid attributes, making it hard to open the route detail/navigation modal via automation. Map is mounted lazily inside the modal, which is fine, but adding testids like 'route-card-view-btn', 'route-card-edit-btn' is recommended.

Login inputs/buttons lack the data-testid='email-input' / 'password-input' / 'submit-button' that the previous iteration report claimed exist. Using generic input[type=email] selectors worked, but adding testids would harden tests.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid to action icons in RoutesPage route-card buttons and to LoginPage inputs/submit for better testability.

(Optional, informational) Browser console emits deprecation warning: 'google.maps.Marker is deprecated' on /track/:token — consider migrating to google.maps.marker.AdvancedMarkerElement when convenient (no functional impact).
critical_code_review_comments: tracking_module.py + routes_module.py are well-structured. Public endpoint correctly strips PII (phone/email) from /tracking/public/{token} response — verified by test. JWT-based share-token with 24h expiry is appropriate.

nav-leg endpoint correctly returns BOTH duration_seconds (with traffic) and static_duration_seconds (without) and a speed_reading_intervals array — matches 'Maps-grade' tracking behavior the user wanted.
Session persistence (/api/tracking/session/start|current|stop|stop-statuses) is implemented and persists in MongoDB — covers the reload-recovery flow.
